visual_enhancers.texture: MANDATORY: Add a fixed SVG noise overlay (`opacity-30 mix-blend-multiply pointer-events-none`) over the entire layout to create a speckled/distressed paper texture.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Physical photo / polaroid style. Images must have a thick white border (`p-2` or `p-3` bg-white), a subtle ambient shadow (`shadow-xl shadow-black/10`), and slight random rotations (`rotate-1`, `-rotate-2`, etc.).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use solid 1px or 2px `#1A1A1A` borders for geometric, editorial separations in the layout.

motion.global: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. The site must feel heavy, tactile, and premium.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic typography reveal. The word 'SRIBAN' animates line-by-line from a hidden mask (Framer Motion `clipPath` or `y` translation inside `overflow-hidden`). Staggered.
motion.scroll_reveal: Asymmetric scroll triggers. Elements fade and translate up slightly (`y: 30`, `opacity: 0` to `1`) as they enter the viewport using framer-motion.
motion.marquee: One slow, continuous editorial marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) using the display font. High contrast, separating the Hero from the About section.
motion.micro_interactions: Hovering over project photos gently lifts them (`-translate-y-2`) and straightens their rotation (`rotate-0`) with a smooth spring transition.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), thick black outline (`border-2 border-brand-ink`), transparent background. On hover, background fills with `brand-red` and text turns `white`.
buttons.typography: Body font, uppercase, bold, wide tracking (`tracking-widest`).

navigation.behavior: Scrolls to sections smoothly using Lenis. Hovering over links animates a small dot or underline.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOISE OVERLAY: You must create a full-screen fixed div with an SVG `<filter>` generating fractalNoise. Set it to `mix-blend-multiply` and `pointer-events-none` with opacity 30%. This is critical for the retro paper look.
FONTS: Import 'Montserrat' (weight 900), 'Dancing Script', and 'DM Sans' from Google Fonts in the index.html or index.css.
DO NOT USE DEFAULT TAILWIND COLORS: Override the config with the specific hex codes provided in this JSON.
POLAROID EFFECT: Every image must be wrapped in a container that adds a thick white padding, border, and a subtle rotation (e.g. `rotate-[-3deg] hover:rotate-0 transition-transform`).
DO NOT CENTER EVERYTHING: Use asymmetrical bento grids or editorial columns (e.g., a massive heading on the left spanning 4 columns, and small body text on the right spanning 2 columns).
TRANSPARENCY: Never use a fully transparent background for headers/navs if content scrolls under it. Use `backdrop-blur-md` with `bg-[#F4F1EA]/80`.
HTML COMPONENTS: Use raw HTML + Tailwind + Framer Motion for marketing layouts. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the project gallery; build a custom collapsible list with polaroid frames.
TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all navigational elements, category toggles, and form submit buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
